component.name: SnapOCR
component.summary: Region screenshot and text capture for COSMIC and Wayland

description.p: Select a region and the image goes straight to the clipboard; or select a region and get its text in an editable window. Includes a small markup editor with a pen, arrows and auto-numbered markers.
Capture uses the freedesktop standard ext-image-copy-capture-v1, so it works on compositors such as cosmic-comp where grim (which needs the older wlr-screencopy protocol) does not.
